title: Re2A: Situated Conversational Recommendation via Rubric-based Preference Reasoning and Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.18249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world recommendation scenarios are commonly grounded in shared physical environments during user-recommender interactions. This motivates situated conversational recommendation (SCR), a complex task requiring recommender assistants to jointly reason over dialogue history, co-observed scenes, and in-scene item attributes. However, current approaches struggle with this setting due to two intertwined challenges: accurately understanding situated user preferences throughout the conversation and generating responses that simultaneously satisfy user needs and grounded situations. To this end, we propose Re2A, a framework that formulates SCR as a structured reason-then-align process. We introduce rubric-based preference reasoning, which uses automated rubrics to guide the model toward producing explicit preference states. translated_title: Re2A：基于量规的偏好推理与对齐实现情境化对话推荐
translated_abstract: 现实世界的推荐场景通常建立在用户与推荐系统交互过程中共享的物理环境之上。这催生了情境化对话推荐（SCR）这一任务——一个复杂的任务，要求推荐助手同时对对话历史、共同观察到的场景以及场景中的物品属性进行联合推理。然而，当前方法由于两个相互交织的挑战而难以应对这一设定：在整个对话过程中准确理解情境化的用户偏好，以及生成同时满足用户需求和实际情境的回复。为此，我们提出了Re2A框架，将SCR形式化为一个结构化的“先推理后对齐”过程。我们引入了基于量规的偏好推理，利用自动化量规引导模型产生显式的偏好状态。基于这些状态，我们提出了偏好条件化优化方法，以双重目标对齐回复生成。
tldr: 提出了Re2A框架，通过基于量规的偏好推理和偏好条件化优化，将情境化对话推荐形式化为“先推理后对齐”的结构化过程，使推荐助手能够准确理解情境化用户偏好并生成同时满足用户需求与实际场景的回复。
